The Python package's classes, functions and values, under the sections of [the R reference](../reference/index.html) and in its order. `import resolve_core as rc` reaches every name below. [Imputing plot attributes from species lists](resolveR.html?lang=python) runs them on the survey that ships with the R package.

## Installation

::: {.lang-pair}
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("gcol33/resolve/r")

# The RESOLVE engine library, downloaded once
library(resolveR)
resolve.install_backend()
```

```bash
pip install resolve-core
```
:::

## [Loading data](python-data.html)

Plots and the species records observed in them, from CSV files or data frames, into a RESOLVE engine dataset.

[`RoleMapping`](python-data.html#RoleMapping)
: Names the columns of the two tables by the part they play in a dataset.

[`TargetSpec`](python-data.html#TargetSpec)
: One target, a plot-table column the model learns to impute, and how its values are read.

[`TaskType`](python-data.html#TaskType)
: The kind of a target: regression or classification.

[`TransformType`](python-data.html#TransformType)
: The transform a regression target is stored under.

[`TargetMissingPolicy`](python-data.html#TargetMissingPolicy)
: What a plot with no value for a target does.

[`DatasetConfig`](python-data.html#DatasetConfig)
: How the species recorded on a plot become model input.

[`SpeciesEncodingMode`](python-data.html#SpeciesEncodingMode)
: The encoding of a plot's species set.

[`SelectionMode`](python-data.html#SelectionMode)
: Which species of a plot fill its budget.

[`RepresentationMode`](python-data.html#RepresentationMode)
: The value a species carries into the encoding: its abundance, or 1.

[`NormalizationMode`](python-data.html#NormalizationMode)
: How the hash weights of a plot's selected species are rescaled.

[`AggregationMode`](python-data.html#AggregationMode)
: How genera and families are ranked and weighted.

[`PoolWeighting`](python-data.html#PoolWeighting)
: The weight a species pools with under the rank-pool and transformer encodings.

[`MissingValuePolicy`](python-data.html#MissingValuePolicy)
: How a blank covariate or coordinate cell enters the model.

[`effective_selection()`](python-data.html#effective_selection)
: The species selection a dataset loaded under a configuration applies.

[`ResolveDataset`](python-data.html#ResolveDataset)
: The loaded and encoded plots, and the loaders that build them.

[`ResolveSchema`](python-data.html#ResolveSchema)
: The structure of a loaded dataset: the input widths, the targets and the vocabularies.

[`TargetConfig`](python-data.html#TargetConfig)
: A target as the dataset loaded it.

[`ExternalVocabs`](python-data.html#ExternalVocabs)
: Every vocabulary a dataset fitted, in the form the loaders that reuse vocabularies take.

[`external_vocabs_from_schema()`](python-data.html#external_vocabs_from_schema)
: The vocabularies a schema carries.

[`EncodingVocab`](python-data.html#EncodingVocab)
: The species and taxonomy vocabularies one encoding codes a plot with.

[`SpeciesVocab`](python-data.html#SpeciesVocab)
: Each species name to an integer code, 0 for an unknown species.

[`TaxonomyVocab`](python-data.html#TaxonomyVocab)
: Each genus and family name to an integer code.

[`CategoricalVocab`](python-data.html#CategoricalVocab)
: The integer codes of each categorical column.

[`SpeciesRecord`](python-data.html#SpeciesRecord)
: One species recorded on one plot.

[`EmbeddingEncoder`](python-data.html#EmbeddingEncoder)
: The embed encoding on its own, outside a dataset.

[`EmbeddingEncodedData`](python-data.html#EmbeddingEncodedData)
: The species and taxonomy slots `EmbeddingEncoder` returns.

[`RankPoolEncoder`](python-data.html#RankPoolEncoder)
: The rank-pool encoding on its own, outside a dataset.

[`RankPoolEncodedData`](python-data.html#RankPoolEncodedData)
: The pooled species, weights and mask `RankPoolEncoder` returns.

[`build_species_graph()`](python-data.html#build_species_graph)
: The graph over the species vocabulary a heterogeneous GNN passes messages on.

[`SpeciesGraph`](python-data.html#SpeciesGraph)
: The edges of a species graph and their types.

[`SpeciesEdgeType`](python-data.html#SpeciesEdgeType)
: The kind of a species-graph edge: same genus, same family or co-occurrence.

## [Training](python-training.html)

Fitting a model, cross-validating it and pretraining its encoder without labels.

[`ResolveModel`](python-training.html#ResolveModel)
: The network: a species encoder, a shared encoder and one output head per target.

[`ModelForwardResult`](python-training.html#ModelForwardResult)
: A forward pass's outputs with its auxiliary loss terms.

[`model_config_for_dataset()`](python-training.html#model_config_for_dataset)
: A model configuration with the fields that size a model taken from its dataset.

[`ModelConfig`](python-training.html#ModelConfig)
: The architecture of a model.

[`FTTransformerConfig`](python-training.html#FTTransformerConfig)
: The settings of the FT-Transformer architecture.

[`TabNetConfig`](python-training.html#TabNetConfig)
: The settings of the TabNet architecture.

[`SAINTConfig`](python-training.html#SAINTConfig)
: The settings of the SAINT architecture.

[`ExcelFormerConfig`](python-training.html#ExcelFormerConfig)
: The settings of the ExcelFormer architecture.

[`GNNConfig`](python-training.html#GNNConfig)
: The settings of the graph neural network over plots.

[`HeterogeneousGNNConfig`](python-training.html#HeterogeneousGNNConfig)
: The settings of the graph neural network over species.

[`TraitNetConfig`](python-training.html#TraitNetConfig)
: The settings of the TraitNet architecture.

[`TabMConfig`](python-training.html#TabMConfig)
: TabM as the encoder's final stage.

[`ParallelLayersConfig`](python-training.html#ParallelLayersConfig)
: A block of parallel branches as the encoder's final stage.

[`ParallelBranchConfig`](python-training.html#ParallelBranchConfig)
: One branch of a parallel block.

[`Trainer`](python-training.html#Trainer)
: Fits a model: the split, the training loop, cross-validation, the held-out evaluations and checkpoints.

[`TrainConfig`](python-training.html#TrainConfig)
: The settings of a training run.

[`TrainResult`](python-training.html#TrainResult)
: The metrics, loss histories and baselines a fit returns.

[`BaselineMetrics`](python-training.html#BaselineMetrics)
: A target's naive baseline beside the model.

[`CrossValidationResult`](python-training.html#CrossValidationResult)
: The metrics of a cross-validation, per fold and across folds.

[`SpatialBlockConfig`](python-training.html#SpatialBlockConfig)
: The latitude and longitude blocks of a spatial cross-validation.

[`ResidualAnalysis`](python-training.html#ResidualAnalysis)
: The residuals of a regression target on the held-out fold.

[`ClassificationPredictions`](python-training.html#ClassificationPredictions)
: The imputed classes and probabilities of a classification target on the held-out fold.

[`CalibrationResult`](python-training.html#CalibrationResult)
: How well a classifier's probabilities match how often it is right.

[`CalibrationBin`](python-training.html#CalibrationBin)
: One bin of the probability given to the imputed class.

[`NetworkDiagnostics`](python-training.html#NetworkDiagnostics)
: The activations of the species encoder's hidden layers.

[`LayerDiagnostics`](python-training.html#LayerDiagnostics)
: The activations of one hidden layer.

[`PretrainConfig`](python-training.html#PretrainConfig)
: The settings of JEPA and SCARF pretraining.

[`JEPAPretrainer`](python-training.html#JEPAPretrainer)
: Pretrains an encoder by predicting the latent of a plot from a masked view of it.

[`SCARFPretrainer`](python-training.html#SCARFPretrainer)
: Pretrains an encoder by matching each plot with a corrupted copy of it.

[`PretrainResult`](python-training.html#PretrainResult)
: The loss history of a pretraining run.

[`MaskStrategy`](python-training.html#MaskStrategy)
: Which features JEPA masks.

[`MLMPretrainConfig`](python-training.html#MLMPretrainConfig)
: The settings of masked-species pretraining.

[`MaskedSpeciesPretrainer`](python-training.html#MaskedSpeciesPretrainer)
: Pretrains a transformer species encoder by naming the species hidden from it.

[`VAEConfig`](python-training.html#VAEConfig)
: The settings of the variational autoencoder.

[`VAEPretrainer`](python-training.html#VAEPretrainer)
: A variational autoencoder of the plots' species vectors.

[`VAEPretrainResult`](python-training.html#VAEPretrainResult)
: The loss histories of a variational autoencoder run.

[`LossConfigMode`](python-training.html#LossConfigMode)
: The regression loss.

[`LRSchedulerType`](python-training.html#LRSchedulerType)
: How the learning rate changes over a run.

[`SelectionMetric`](python-training.html#SelectionMetric)
: The held-out value a run selects its epoch by.

[`ActivationType`](python-training.html#ActivationType)
: The activation functions.

[`NormLayerType`](python-training.html#NormLayerType)
: The normalisation layers.

[`EncoderArchitecture`](python-training.html#EncoderArchitecture)
: The architecture of the shared encoder.

[`MoERoutingType`](python-training.html#MoERoutingType)
: How a mixture of experts routes a plot.

[`MoEPlacement`](python-training.html#MoEPlacement)
: Where the mixture of experts sits in the encoder.

[`GNNType`](python-training.html#GNNType)
: The graph layer of the graph neural network over plots.

[`GraphConstructionMode`](python-training.html#GraphConstructionMode)
: What the plot graph measures neighbourhood on.

[`TraitInteractionMode`](python-training.html#TraitInteractionMode)
: How TraitNet combines the environment and a species' traits.

[`TabMAggregation`](python-training.html#TabMAggregation)
: How TabM combines its ensemble.

[`TransformerPooling`](python-training.html#TransformerPooling)
: How the transformer encoding pools its species tokens.

[`ParallelAggregation`](python-training.html#ParallelAggregation)
: How a parallel block combines its branches.

## [Saving and imputing](python-prediction.html)

Checkpoints, what they record about the run, and imputed values for new plots.

[`Predictor`](python-prediction.html#Predictor)
: Imputed values, latent representations and embedding tables from a trained model.

[`ResolvePredictions`](python-prediction.html#ResolvePredictions)
: The imputed values and class probabilities for every plot.

[`RetrievalConfig`](python-prediction.html#RetrievalConfig)
: The settings of retrieval augmentation.

[`nearest_by_cosine()`](python-prediction.html#nearest_by_cosine)
: The rows of a reference set most similar to each query row by cosine similarity.

[`Scalers`](python-prediction.html#Scalers)
: The input and target scaling fitted on the training plots.

[`RunMetadata`](python-prediction.html#RunMetadata)
: The run as a checkpoint records it: split, timing, epochs and final metrics.

[`HoldOutMode`](python-prediction.html#HoldOutMode)
: How a run's held-out fold was drawn.

[`dataset_config_from_checkpoint()`](python-prediction.html#dataset_config_from_checkpoint)
: The loader settings a checkpoint was trained under.

[`target_specs_from_schema()`](python-prediction.html#target_specs_from_schema)
: The targets a checkpoint was trained on.

## [Model suites](python-suites.html)

Several trained models released as one directory and scored together.

[`SuiteManifest`](python-suites.html#SuiteManifest)
: A suite's manifest: the input contract, the targets, their members and the provenance.

[`SuiteInputContract`](python-suites.html#SuiteInputContract)
: The columns a suite reads and how their values are read.

[`SuiteTarget`](python-suites.html#SuiteTarget)
: One released target of a suite.

[`SuiteTargetInputs`](python-suites.html#SuiteTargetInputs)
: The part of the input contract a target's members read.

[`SuiteMember`](python-suites.html#SuiteMember)
: One checkpoint of a suite target.

[`SuiteCombine`](python-suites.html#SuiteCombine)
: How a suite target combines its members.

[`SuiteTargetStatus`](python-suites.html#SuiteTargetStatus)
: Released or experimental.

[`SuitePredictor`](python-suites.html#SuitePredictor)
: A suite loaded from its directory, scored as one model.

[`SuiteColumns`](python-suites.html#SuiteColumns)
: Renames the manifest's input columns at imputation time.

[`SuitePredictions`](python-suites.html#SuitePredictions)
: Every target's imputed values, and the table they are written as.

[`SuiteTargetPrediction`](python-suites.html#SuiteTargetPrediction)
: One target's combined imputed value, the members' agreement or spread, and the species recognition.

[`suite_prediction_columns()`](python-suites.html#suite_prediction_columns)
: The imputed values as named columns, one value per plot.

[`CombinedPrediction`](python-suites.html#CombinedPrediction)
: A combined imputed value with its agreement or dispersion.

[`combine_vote()`](python-suites.html#combine_vote)
: The class most members impute.

[`combine_mean()`](python-suites.html#combine_mean)
: The members' mean and standard deviation.

[`combine_circular()`](python-suites.html#combine_circular)
: The members' circular mean and circular standard deviation.

[`combine_spherical()`](python-suites.html#combine_spherical)
: The members' mean point on the sphere and their spread in km.

[`bearing_from_components()`](python-suites.html#bearing_from_components)
: A bearing from its sine and cosine.

[`EARTH_RADIUS_KM`](python-suites.html#EARTH_RADIUS_KM)
: The Earth radius the spherical mean measures distances with.

[`sha256_file()`](python-suites.html#sha256_file)
: The SHA-256 digest of a file.

## [Gap fitting](python-gap-fitting.html)

Imputing a dataset's missing values from its own complete plots, beside the raw imputed value.

[`fit_gaps()`](python-gap-fitting.html#fit_gaps)
: One target's gaps from the raw imputed value, the recorded values and the plots' composition, positions and years.

[`fit_prediction_gaps()`](python-gap-fitting.html#fit_prediction_gaps)
: A single model's gaps from its imputed values and the dataset's tables.

[`read_gap_tables()`](python-gap-fitting.html#read_gap_tables)
: What gap fitting reads about a dataset's plots, from DataFrames or CSV paths.

[`GapFittingConfig`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapFittingConfig)
: The candidates, the neighbour counts, spatial neighbours on or off, the folds and the fold layout's seed, largest fold share and matching sample.

[`GapTarget`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapTarget)
: A target's name, scale and period.

[`GapScale`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapScale)
: How a target's values lie: linear, log, circular or geographic.

[`GapMethod`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapMethod)
: The methods a gap can be imputed by.

[`GapFit`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapFit)
: The fitted values, the method per plot and the report.

[`gap_folds()`](python-gap-fitting.html#gap_folds)
: The fold layout the choice is judged on.

[`GapColumns`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapColumns), [`GapTables`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapTables), [`GapFitRequest`](python-gap-fitting.html#GapFitRequest)
: The low-level columns, tables and requests the functions above build.

## [Terrain correction](python-terrain-correction.html)

Altitude and slope combined with an elevation model read at the plots, and the elevation model a suite ships.

[`TerrainGrids`, `open_terrain_field()`, `TerrainCodedField`, `TerrainField`](python-terrain-correction.html#sources)
: Elevation grids on disk and terrain field files, as sources of elevations.

[`terrain_descriptors()`](python-terrain-correction.html#terrain_descriptors)
: The elevation, the 1 km mean, the slope and the 1 km inclination at coordinates.

[`encode_terrain_grids()`](python-terrain-correction.html#encode_terrain_grids)
: Elevation grids coded into a terrain field with a bounded error per cell.

[`fit_terrain_tile()`, `assemble_terrain_field()`](python-terrain-correction.html#fit_terrain_tile)
: The neural terrain field format, tile by tile.

[`fit_terrain_correction()`](python-terrain-correction.html#fit_terrain_correction)
: The gated correction of one target, fitted on plots with recorded values.

[`TerrainCorrection`](python-terrain-correction.html#TerrainCorrection)
: A fitted correction: apply, save, load.

[`nearest_by_great_circle()`](python-gap-fitting.html#nearest_by_great_circle)
: The nearest rows of a reference set by great-circle distance.

## [Species names](python-names.html)

Species names read as the names a model learnt.

[`resolve_names()`](python-names.html#resolve_names)
: Resolve species names against a model's vocabulary, with the route each takes.

[`NameTable`](python-names.html#NameTable)
: The release's name table: entered names and synonyms with the token each stands for.

[`SpeciesNames`](python-names.html#SpeciesNames)
: How a load or a suite imputation resolves species names.

[`NameResolver`](python-names.html#NameResolver)
: Resolves names against one vocabulary.

[`ResolvedName`](python-names.html#ResolvedName)
: What the resolver gives for one name.

[`NameRoute`](python-names.html#NameRoute)
: Exact, alias, spelling or unresolved.

[`SpeciesNameReport`](python-names.html#SpeciesNameReport)
: The names a load or a suite target did not find as written.

## [Scoring](python-scoring.html)

The metrics training reports, for values imputed anywhere.

[`Metrics`](python-scoring.html#Metrics)
: The regression and classification metrics as functions of two tensors.

[`ClassificationMetrics`](python-scoring.html#ClassificationMetrics)
: Accuracy, F1 scores and the confusion matrix of a classification.

[`ConfidenceMetrics`](python-scoring.html#ConfidenceMetrics)
: The accuracy and coverage of the imputed values above a confidence threshold.

[`compute_species_recognition()`](python-scoring.html#compute_species_recognition)
: How much of each plot's species list a vocabulary recognises.

[`SpeciesRecognition`](python-scoring.html#SpeciesRecognition)
: The recognised species of each plot, by count and by abundance.

[`compute_unknown_species_stats()`](python-scoring.html#compute_unknown_species_stats)
: The unknown-species columns of each plot against a vocabulary.

[`UnknownSpeciesStats`](python-scoring.html#UnknownSpeciesStats)
: Each plot's unknown share of abundance and number of unknown species.

## [The RESOLVE engine](python-engine.html)

The RESOLVE engine loaded, its memory and thread settings, its errors, and the index that matches names within a few edits.

[`__version__`](python-engine.html#__version__)
: The version of the RESOLVE engine loaded.

[`set_vram_fraction()`](python-engine.html#set_vram_fraction)
: Caps the share of GPU memory the RESOLVE engine may use.

[`configure_cuda_allocator()`](python-engine.html#configure_cuda_allocator)
: Sets the CUDA allocator's configuration to the RESOLVE engine's default.

[`default_cuda_alloc_conf()`](python-engine.html#default_cuda_alloc_conf)
: The RESOLVE engine's default CUDA allocator configuration.

[`set_thread_pools()`](python-engine.html#set_thread_pools)
: Sets the number of threads libtorch uses.

[`install_crash_handler()`](python-engine.html#install_crash_handler)
: Makes a native fault end the process at once on Windows.

[`StorageError`](python-engine.html#StorageError)
: The exception for a file the RESOLVE engine cannot read or write.

[`fuzzy`](python-engine.html#fuzzy)
: The submodule of the name index.

[`fuzzy.FuzzyIndex`](python-engine.html#fuzzy.FuzzyIndex)
: An index that returns the entries within a few edits of a query.

[`fuzzy.Match`](python-engine.html#fuzzy.Match)
: One match a query returns.
